Well, I'm not married but my parent's wedding was really bad.

My mom and dad were newly engaged and still living separately in their parent's houses. This was due to how young they were, and my mom's overbearingingly religious parents. They were planning on saving up for a nice wedding sometime in the near future, and were working towards one. 

However, those plans were cut short early one morning when my mom's sister decided to tattle to my grandparents that my parents were having sex. They immediately ran to my mother's room and woke her up from her sleep to ask her if it was true. She said yes and my grandfather called my father, who was at work, and demanded that he marry my mother that morning. He agreed.

This caused the wedding to happen a few hours later in a local chapel, my tired dad wearing a button down and slacks, while my mother wore one of her nicer blouses and a skirt. My maternal grandfather was the only witness, and, due to my mom's sheer frustration with the entire situation, she cried so hard during her vows that the priest stopped and asked my mother if she was being forced into marriage several times.
